question: Which of the following elements is present in common table salt?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Table salt is chemically known as **sodium chloride (NaCl)**.
 
• The major component of table salt is **sodium (Na)**, which is an essential electrolyte in the human body.
 
• Sodium is crucial for **maintaining fluid balance, nerve function, and muscle contractions**.
 
• In common salt, sodium ions combine with chloride ions to form a stable ionic compound.
 
• Table salt is widely used in cooking and food preservation due to its ability to enhance flavor and prevent microbial growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electrolytes:**

 
 
• Electrolytes like sodium, potassium, and chloride are essential for maintaining the body's fluid balance and electrical activity in cells.
 
• Sodium levels are tightly regulated by the kidneys through processes like reabsorption and excretion.
 
 
 
• **Health Impacts of Sodium:**
 
 
• Excessive sodium intake can lead to conditions like **hypertension (high blood pressure)**, which increases the risk of cardiovascular diseases.
 
• Low sodium levels (hyponatremia) can result in symptoms like fatigue, confusion, and muscle weakness.
 
 
 
• **Chloride in Salt:**
 
 
• Chloride (Cl⁻) is the other component of sodium chloride, playing a vital role in maintaining the body's acid-base balance.
 
• It also supports digestion by contributing to the production of hydrochloric acid (HCl) in the stomach.
 
 
 
• **Types of Salt:**
 
 
• Besides table salt, other types include sea salt, Himalayan pink salt, and kosher salt, each varying in mineral content and texture.
 
• Table salt is often fortified with iodine to prevent iodine deficiency disorders like goiter.
